name: Quloub
overview: Four female friends reunite after years, and instead of memories, cracks begin to surface, toxic marriages, forbidden desires, social shame and denied identities; between sex, religion and women’s rights, each of them challenges in her own way the rigid rules of an Egypt that preaches morality but lives on hypocrisy, and Quloub doesn’t comfort but exposes, forcing you to confront what society would rather bury, especially when women refuse to stay silent
